epic.description: Allow registered users to sign in securely with email and password, including account lockout protection, persistent sessions via Remember Me, and accessible password entry.

story.summary: As a registered user I want to log in with my email and password so that I can access my dashboard
story.description: Login page with email and password fields, a show/hide password toggle and a Remember Me option. Five failed attempts within 15 minutes lock the account for 15 minutes. Successful login redirects to /dashboard.
acceptance_criteria: Given a registered user with valid credentials, When they submit the login form, Then they are redirected to /dashboard
Given the email or password field is empty, When the user submits, Then a required-field error is shown and no login request is made
Given 5 failed login attempts within 15 minutes, When the user tries again, Then the account is locked for 15 minutes
Given Remember Me is checked, When the user logs in, Then they stay signed in for 30 days
Given the password field, When the user types, Then characters are masked, And the show/hide toggle reveals or hides them

test_cases.title: Login with valid email and password
test_cases.preconditions: Registered, active user account exists
test_cases.expected_result: User is authenticated and redirected to /dashboard

test_cases.title: Submit with empty email and password
test_cases.preconditions: User is on the login page
test_cases.expected_result: Required-field errors are shown for both fields; no login request is sent; user stays on login page

test_cases.title: Submit with email only (password empty)
test_cases.preconditions: User is on the login page
test_cases.expected_result: Password required error is shown; login is not attempted

test_cases.title: Submit with password only (email empty)
test_cases.preconditions: User is on the login page
test_cases.expected_result: Email required error is shown; login is not attempted

test_cases.title: Login with wrong password
test_cases.preconditions: Registered user account exists
test_cases.expected_result: Generic error such as 'Invalid email or password' is shown; user stays on login page

test_cases.title: Login with unregistered email shows same generic error
test_cases.preconditions: Email is not registered
test_cases.expected_result: Same generic error message and similar response time as TC-005, so it does not reveal whether the account exists

test_cases.title: Invalid email format is rejected
test_cases.preconditions: User is on the login page
test_cases.expected_result: Validation error for invalid email format is shown for each value

test_cases.title: Account locks after 5 failed attempts within 15 minutes
test_cases.preconditions: Registered user account with no recent failed attempts
steps: Enter valid email with wrong password and submit 5 times within 15 minutes
Attempt a 6th login with the correct password
test_cases.test_data: Email: qa.user@example.com, Wrong: Wrong@999, Correct: Valid@1234
test_cases.expected_result: After the 5th failure the account is locked; the 6th attempt with the correct password is rejected with a lockout message

test_cases.title: 4 failed attempts do not lock the account
test_cases.preconditions: Registered user account with no recent failed attempts
test_cases.expected_result: Account is not locked; 5th attempt with correct password logs in and redirects to /dashboard

test_cases.title: Failed attempts spread over more than 15 minutes do not lock
test_cases.preconditions: Registered user account; ability to control time or wait
test_cases.expected_result: Account is not locked because only 2 failures fall within the latest 15-minute window; login succeeds

test_cases.title: Account unlocks after 15-minute lockout period
test_cases.preconditions: Account is locked as in TC-008
steps: Wait just under 15 minutes and try the correct password
Wait until 15 minutes have passed and try the correct password again
test_cases.expected_result: Attempt before 15 minutes is rejected; attempt after 15 minutes succeeds and redirects to /dashboard

test_cases.title: Remember Me keeps user signed in after browser restart
test_cases.preconditions: Registered user account
test_cases.expected_result: User is still signed in and lands on /dashboard without logging in again; session cookie expiry is about 30 days

test_cases.title: Without Remember Me the session ends when browser closes
test_cases.preconditions: Registered user account
steps: Log in without checking Remember Me
test_cases.expected_result: User is redirected to the login page

test_cases.title: Remember Me session expires after 30 days
test_cases.preconditions: Logged in with Remember Me; ability to advance time or edit cookie expiry in test environment
steps: Advance time to 29 days and open /dashboard
Advance time beyond 30 days and open /dashboard
test_cases.expected_result: At 29 days the user is still signed in; after 30 days the user is redirected to login

test_cases.title: Password is masked and show/hide toggle works
test_cases.preconditions: User is on the login page
test_cases.expected_result: Password is masked by default, shown as plain text after Show, masked again after Hide; typed value is unchanged

test_cases.title: SQL injection and script input are handled safely
test_cases.preconditions: User is on the login page
steps: Enter injection payloads in email and password
test_cases.expected_result: Login fails with the generic error; no script executes; no database error or stack trace is shown

test_cases.title: Credentials are sent securely and not exposed
test_cases.preconditions: Browser developer tools open
steps: Inspect the network request and the URL
test_cases.expected_result: Request uses HTTPS and POST; password is not in the URL or logs; session cookie has Secure, HttpOnly and SameSite flags

test_cases.title: Dashboard is not accessible without logging in
test_cases.preconditions: User is logged out
test_cases.expected_result: User is redirected to the login page

test_cases.title: Email field trims spaces and ignores case
test_cases.preconditions: Registered user qa.user@example.com
steps: Enter the email with leading/trailing spaces and uppercase letters
test_cases.expected_result: Login succeeds (confirm expected behaviour with product owner if not specified)

test_cases.title: Login form is fully keyboard accessible
test_cases.preconditions: User is on the login page
steps: Use Tab to move through email, password, show/hide toggle, Remember Me and Log in
Press Space on the toggle and checkbox
test_cases.expected_result: Logical focus order, visible focus indicator on each control, all controls work by keyboard, Enter submits the form

test_cases.title: Screen reader announces labels and errors
test_cases.preconditions: Screen reader enabled (NVDA or VoiceOver)
steps: Navigate the form with the screen reader
test_cases.expected_result: Fields have announced labels; errors are announced and linked to their fields; the toggle announces its state (e.g. 'Show password')
